<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>You really think you can cut this thing down? Show me
what you’ve got, pal!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Achas mesmo que pode cortar isto?
o que você tem, amigo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)>WHOA! You really did it! You cut that fence like it was
paper! Awesome!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>Classic <$cdef(27)>! I knew you’d handle it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)>Cortaste a cerca como se fosse uma armadilha.
Papel, fantástico!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>Classico <$cdef(27)>Eu sabia que você iria lidar com isso!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)>Now we can finally go farther in, but... Is it just me or is it
ridiculously hot?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Seems like the heat’s comin’ from deep within. And I’m no
good with hot places...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)>Agora podemos finalmente ir mais longe, mas... sou só eu ou...
Ridiculamente quente?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Parece que o calor está vindo de dentro. E eu não sou
bom com lugares quentes...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>You know what they say: if ya can’t stand the heat, get
outta the tunnel! So I’ll head back now.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>But hey, you should totally go farther in and check it out!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Maybe you’ll meet some Pokémon who love livin’ in super
hot spots!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Você sabe o que eles dizem: se você não pode suportar o calor, obter
Então eu vou voltar agora.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Mas devias ir mais longe e verificar!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Talvez você vai encontrar alguns Pokémon que amam viver’ no super
Pontos quentes!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Meanwhile, I should probably go cool off these fists...
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,31)>They’re startin’ to swell up from all that fence-punchin’
from earlier. Ow...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Entretanto, é melhor ir refrescar-me com estes punhos...
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,31)>Eles estão começando’ para inchar de todo aquele cerca-punchin’
De há pouco.

dialogues.en: *ring ring!*
dialogues.pt_br: Anel de anel!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>I was just poking around on the <$cdef(27)>PC when it apparently
decided to connect me with you again!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,4)>How are things on your end?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>Eu estava só a bisbilhotar. <$cdef(27)>PC quando aparentemente
Decidi ligar-me a ti outra vez!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,4)>Como estão as coisas do teu lado?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)>Oh, you’re in a tunnel, are you? The mountains around
here all seem to be volcanoes, <$voicel(1,6)>so I’m very much inclined
to believe you that it’s hot in there!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Oh! That reminds me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)>Oh, você está em um túnel, não é? As montanhas ao redor
aqui todos parecem ser vulcões, <$voicel(1,6)>por isso estou muito inclinado
acreditar em você que está quente lá dentro!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Isso faz-me lembrar!

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>But I’m afraid I don’t know how to actually use a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>For example, there’s a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Magmar—they’re

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>You could try making a home that would appeal to

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Por exemplo, há um Pokémon chamado <$cdef(27)>Magmar—são
todos nascidos em vulcões muito parecidos com o que você está agora.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Podias tentar fazer um lar que apelasse para
a <$cdef(27)>Magmar!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Then, if you’re able to meet a <$cdef(27)>Magmar, that’s your chance
to ask about a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I’d wager they could teach you all about it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Então, se você é capaz de encontrar um <$cdef(27)>Magmar, Essa é a sua chance
para perguntar sobre um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Eu apostaria que eles poderiam ensiná-lo tudo sobre isso!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Well, I won’t keep you any longer! Be careful around all

dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Bem, Eu não vou mantê-lo mais! Tenha cuidado em torno de todos
aqueles lugares perigosos, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s about melting <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(114)>.

dialogues.pt_br:

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>It’ll take a little time, so...come by and look later, OK?

If you’d like to get started right away, bring a Pokémon
